form.label: Aruba Central - Wireless Overview
form.description: AP status, sessions (clientCount), CPU/memory, swarm conductor and AP throughput from TA_hpe_aruba_central.

search.query: `aruba_central_index` sourcetype="aruba:central:ap" siteName="$site$" earliest=-30m | stats latest(status) as status by serialNumber | where status="ONLINE" | stats count
`aruba_central_index` sourcetype="aruba:central:ap" siteName="$site$" earliest=-30m | stats latest(status) as status by serialNumber | where status!="ONLINE" | stats count

panel.title: Wireless sessions (sum of clientCount, latest poll)

search.query: `aruba_central_index` sourcetype="aruba:central:ap" siteName="$site$" earliest=-30m | stats latest(clientCount) as clientCount by serialNumber | stats sum(clientCount) as sessions

panel.title: Access points (latest state) with swarm conductor

search.query: `aruba_central_index` sourcetype="aruba:central:ap" siteName="$site$" | stats latest(deviceName) as AP latest(status) as status latest(clientCount) as sessions latest(cpuUtilization) as cpu_pct latest(memoryUtilization) as mem_pct latest(siteName) as site latest(model) as model latest(firmwareVersion) as firmware latest(clusterId) as clusterId latest(clusterName) as swarm latest(_time) as last_poll by serialNumber | join type=left max=1 clusterId [ search `aruba_central_index` sourcetype="aruba:central:swarm" | stats latest(conductorDeviceName) as conductor latest(conductorSerialNumber) as conductor_serial by clusterId ] | eval cpu_pct=tonumber(cpu_pct), mem_pct=tonumber(mem_pct), sessions=tonumber(sessions) | eval last_poll=strftime(last_poll, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table AP serialNumber status sessions cpu_pct mem_pct site swarm conductor conductor_serial model firmware last_poll | sort status AP

`aruba_central_index` sourcetype="aruba:central:ap" siteName="$site$" | bin _time span=5m | stats latest(clientCount) as clientCount by _time serialNumber | timechart span=5m sum(clientCount) as sessions

panel.title: Max CPU / memory utilisation across APs (%)

search.query: `aruba_central_index` sourcetype="aruba:central:ap" siteName="$site$" | timechart span=5m max(cpuUtilization) as max_cpu_pct max(memoryUtilization) as max_mem_pct

`aruba_central_index` sourcetype="aruba:central:ap_throughput" siteName="$site$" | bin _time span=5m | stats avg(tx) as tx avg(rx) as rx by _time serialNumber | timechart span=5m sum(tx) as tx_bps sum(rx) as rx_bps

`aruba_central_index` sourcetype="aruba:central:ap_throughput" siteName="$site$" | stats avg(tx) as avg_tx_bps avg(rx) as avg_rx_bps max(tx) as max_tx_bps max(rx) as max_rx_bps latest(deviceName) as AP by serialNumber | eval avg_total_bps=avg_tx_bps+avg_rx_bps | sort - avg_total_bps | head 10 | foreach *_bps [ eval <<FIELD>>=round('<<FIELD>>', 0) ] | table AP serialNumber avg_total_bps avg_tx_bps avg_rx_bps max_tx_bps max_rx_bps
